description: Writes or overwrites the context document for a UIForge project in the centralized store. Use this to keep the source of truth up-to-date after architectural decisions, status changes, roadmap updates, or any significant project change. Provide the full markdown content — this completely replaces the existing context.

content.description: Full markdown content of the project context document. This is the complete source of truth.

description.description: One-sentence description of the project for the resource listing

project.description: Project slug (e.g. forge-patterns, uiforge-webapp, uiforge-mcp, mcp-gateway). Use a short kebab-case identifier for new projects.

name: update_project_context
